errors.text_span: Топографска диаграмма посочава съдържание на приблизителни стойности
errors.evidence: The chart is a bar chart, not a 'topographic diagram'.

The description does not mention the x-axis represents months labeled with Roman numerals from I to XII.
The description does not mention the y-axis represents percentages labeled as '%'.
The description does not mention the y-axis range from 0,000 to 140,000 with intervals of 20.
The description does not mention that the bars are grouped by month and represent data for each year.
The description does not mention that blue represents 2022.
The description does not mention that orange represents 2023.
The description does not mention that gray represents 2024.
The description does not mention the maximum value in December 2022 exceeding 120,000.
The description does not mention the minimum value in July and December 2023 being 80,000.
The description does not mention that the bars are vertically aligned in groups by month for easy comparison.
The description does not mention the trend that 2024 generally has the highest values.
